title: Leonardo DiCaprio's Titanic Co-Star Drives His Girlfriend 'Crazy' - Source - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
1 hours ago Photo Credit: Jesse Grant/2026GG/Penske Media via Getty Images Leonardo DiCaprio’ s girlfriend reportedly is “bothered” by his Titanic co-star and longtime friend, Kate Winslet. Fans are aware of the fact that DiCaprio shares a warm and beautiful friendship with Winslet that has stood the test of time. According to Radar Online, Winslet is omnipresent in her Titanic co-star’s life, constantly offering him advice about his personal life. This hasn’t gone down well with his girlfriend of two years, Vittoria Ceretti.
Vittoria Ceretti has problems with Kate Winslet, sources suggest Leonardo DiCaprio’s girlfriend , Vittoria Ceretti, is reportedly unhappy with Kate Winslet’s involvement in their personal life. A source revealed to Radar Online that Ceretti does not like how DiCaprio idolizes Winslet and seeks her opinion on everything in his life.
The source shared, “What bothers her is having to share him with another woman. She complains that he values Kate’s opinion more than hers. She says every time they hit a bump, he somehow ends up bringing up what Kate thinks or what Kate once told him. It drives her crazy because she feels like she is competing with this idealized version of Kate that Leo has built up over 25 years.”
Previously, Winslet admitted that the duo are best friends and there is nothing romantic between them. The Mare of Easttown star also revealed their relationship is like brother-sister, and any physical intimacy would be “absolutely like incest.”
Winslet remarked, “Luckily, and this was the fortunate thing, we never fancied each other. I know that’s really annoying to hear, sorry. We really never did.” However, The Reader star confessed to staying over at DiCaprio’s place whenever she visits Hollywood. Sources have chimed in that this is like a sore point for his girlfriend of two years, Ceretti.
According to Radar Online’s source, Ceretti is done playing the second fiddle in the relationship and plans on giving her Oscar-winning boyfriend an ultimatum.
The source dished, “She respects the friendship, but she also thinks Kate inserts herself way too much and Leo lets her. The way he jumps when Kate calls or texts drives Vittoria crazy.”
Furthermore, the source added, “But when she points it out, Leo just gets defensive, and they end up fighting. Now Vittoria’s threatening to give him an ultimatum. She’s not going to play second fiddle to another woman, even if that woman is just a ‘friend.’”
Originally reported by Anwaya Mane on Mandatory
The post Leonardo DiCaprio’s Titanic Co-Star Drives His Girlfriend ‘Crazy’ — Source appeared first on Reality Tea .
